description: This file contains testing extensions for CanvasWindowController, providing internal test functions for sanitizing session keys, handling JavaScript string literals, storing/restoring window frames, parsing IPv4 addresses, and checking if an IP is in a local network or if a URL is local network canvas URL. These functions are wrapped in a debug conditional, indicating they are used for internal testing purposes.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: Extension adds static test methods to the CanvasWindowController class for internal testing and debugging.

methods.name: _testSanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the session key.

methods.name: _testJSStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JavaScript string literal for the provided string.

methods.name: _testJSOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns an optional JavaScript string literal for the provided optional string.

methods.name: _testStoredFrameKey
methods.description: Generates a storage key for a frame based on session key.

methods.name: _testStoreAndLoadFrame
methods.description: Stores the frame with a session key and then attempts to load it, returning the restored frame.

methods.name: _testParseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into individual byte components.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if the given IPv4 address is within a local network range.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to a local network canvas URL.
